name: Overwhelmed
overview: Scripture reveals that when believers face overwhelming challenges, the Lord attentively hears their cries and delivers them from trouble, offering rest to those who come to Him burdened. God’s intimate knowledge of His people, as shown in His thorough searching and understanding, assures us that no trial is beyond His care. Jesus reminds us that what is impossible for man is possible with God, encouraging reliance on His power amid overwhelming circumstances. Furthermore, the joy found in God’s Word sustains the heart, providing strength and hope during times of distress.
